title: PTAB IPR/PGR institution and final-written-decision rates, FY2024
description: Institution and final-written-decision (FWD) outcome rates for the `ptab-patent-trial-appeal-board` pack, replacing the pack's teaching-estimate probabilities on `institution-decision` and `fwd-issued` with USPTO's own FY2024 trial statistics. Covers Oct. 1, 2023 - Sept. 30, 2024 (USPTO fiscal year). Does not calibrate the merits-vs-Fintiv split of institution denials (the source reports only a single 'denied' total): the two denial edges' prior, unsourced teaching-estimate probabilities (0.2 / 0.15) are explicitly cleared rather than left in place, so they don't dilute the real 0.6810 institution-granted rate by renormalization (a cleared authored value plus one real one would otherwise both be treated as 'authored' and renormalized together) — the engine instead splits the 0.319 residual evenly between them and reports a `probability-fill` warning naming the gap, which `{"op":"calibration"}` also surfaces as a ranked candidate for the next calibration pass.

source.title: PTAB Trial Statistics FY24 End of Year Outcome Roundup — IPR, PGR

entries.method: Slide 6, 'Institution rates by petition' (FY20-FY24): FY24 Instituted 740, Denied 347. 740 / (740 + 347) = 0.68069... rounded to 0.6810.

source.title: PTAB Trial Statistics FY24 End of Year Outcome Roundup — IPR, PGR

entries.method: Clears the pack's prior unsourced 0.2 teaching estimate. The source reports only a combined institution-denied total (347 of 1087, captured on `institution-granted`'s complement); it does not break denials down by merits vs. Fintiv-discretion reason, so this edge is left unauthored rather than guessing a split — the engine's residual-probability fallback splits the denial mass evenly with `institution-denied-fintiv` and reports `probability-fill`.

entries.method: Slide 10, 'Outcomes by petition' (FY24): of petitions that received a final written decision, FWD All Unpatentable 312, FWD Mixed 67, FWD All Patentable 67 (446 total FWDs). 312 / 446 = 0.69955..., conditioned on reaching an FWD (fwd-issued's own probability of firing is a graph-structural certainty once instituted and not settled/dismissed pre-FWD, which this pack models separately upstream of fwd-issued).
